description:
Start a paid Higgsfield Genjutsu video (POST /api/v1/higgsfield/genjutsu/{kind}/generate).

kind motion/swap selects Genjutsu: source 4-30 s (swap: at least 409600 frame pixels).
light-motion/light-swap selects Light: the first 15 s are used and source audio is kept.
Needs video_url, image_urls (1-8), resolution 480p/720p/1080p and optional prompt. Media is
a public HTTPS URL or a key/url from upload_media. Light charges input plus rounded output
seconds at List price. Run estimate_higgsfield_genjutsu first; pass cost_rub as max_cost_rub.
Optional webhook_url (public HTTPS) is called when the video completes or fails; otherwise
follow the job with get_video. While it is still queued cancel_higgsfield_video cancels it
and refunds the charge.
name: create_higgsfield_genjutsu
